title: Paper metadata above the PDF; ⓘ keeps only provenance and search details
description: User feedback on 2026-10-10, after ARA-097 merged: "ARA-097 ended with a bad design. I didn't like how that i icon pops up from the left. Basically You should have the title author list venue abstract. etc all kinds of metadata we have on top of the PDF viewer part. Just similar to before. But somewhere we should maintain a i icon that will list Where this information came from, search index etc irrelevant detail stuff." ARA-097 put every detail, bibliography included, in a side sheet behind ⓘ. This ticket moves the bibliography back onto the page above the PDF, as the old Details tab showed it, and turns ⓘ into a small modal for the behind-the-scenes details only. ARA-097's tabless reader, PDF menu and Remove PDF behaviour stay.
acceptance_criteria: Given a paper's workspace, when the reader shows, then a paper header at the top of the reader column, above the PDF, shows the title, all authors, the citation line (year, venue in italics), DOI and record links, and the abstract clamped with Show more, plus Edit details. Missing fields read plainly or are omitted, never as raw placeholders.

Given a long PDF, when the user reads it, then the header doesn't permanently take reading space. It scrolls away with the document, or collapses to a compact row, and comes back at the top. Page tracking, citation jumps and highlights, zoom and fit-width keep working.
Given a paper without a ready PDF, when the reader shows its ways to get one, then the same header sits above them, and the abstract is not shown twice.
Given reader tabs for other papers (multi-paper chats), when a tab is active, then the header describes that tab's paper.

Given the ⓘ button in the paper header, when it is pressed, then a centred modal dialog (not a side sheet) lists only the behind-the-scenes details: where each field came from with Look up again, catalog identifiers, and the search index. Esc and close return focus to ⓘ. Delete paper… stays reachable from the workspace.
Given a 390px screen, when the PDF segment shows, then the header fits with no horizontal scroll, and the dialog fits the screen.
Given the codebase, when this lands, then PaperDetailsSheet and anything used only by it are deleted, with no second implementation.
test_cases: Header renders the bibliography for a full and a sparse paper; abstract clamps and expands.
Header follows the active reader tab.
No-PDF state shows the header once and no duplicate abstract.
ⓘ opens a dialog with sources, Look up again, identifiers and the search index, and none of the bibliography; focus returns.
Citation jump still scrolls to and highlights the passage with the header present.
Visual check: desktop light and dark, 390px.
verification: Planned on 2026-10-10 from the user's feedback on ARA-097. Branch feat/ara-101-paper-header.
